mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_usage ( usage_date, provider, api_name, call_count, fail_count, error_at, last_error ) VALUES ( #{usageDate}, #{provider}, #{apiName}, #{callCount}, #{failCount}, CASE WHEN #{failCount} > 0 THEN now() END, #{error, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ON CONFLICT (usage_date, provider, api_name) DO UPDATE SET call_count = api_usage.call_count + EXCLUDED.call_count, fail_count = api_usage.fail_count + EXCLUDED.fail_count, error_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.error_at, api_usage.error_at), last_error = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_error, api_usage.last_error)
